verdict.rationale: Editor tooling such as a TypeScript language-service plugin is a fair axis for a React framework, so the story applies. The evidence pack never documents a language service, editor plugin, autocompletion, or inline type-error integration. A community remark calling Next.js a 'great isomorphic TS framework' does not describe editor tooling and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can get accurate autocompletion and inline type errors in my editor via a language service integration
